blocks.text: Elevate your lighting with the Rainermen Ceramic Table Lamp, a stylish accent piece that blends texture and sophistication. Crafted from durable ceramic, this lamp features a herringbone pattern enriched with a transparent white glaze for a subtle sheen that complements modern, eclectic or transitional decor. The drum hardback fabric shade softens the light, creating a warm and inviting glow for your living room, bedroom or home office. Designed with an easy on/off switch and a standard E26 socket, it accommodates a type A bulb up to 60 watts or LED equivalent (bulb not included). UL listed for safety, this table lamp offers both form and function, making it an ideal choice for bedside lighting or as a decorative accent on an end table. Assembly required.

items.label: CERAMIC TABLE LAMP
items.value: Reflecting your effortlessly chic sensibility, the textural surface is enriched with a herringbone pattern and a gorgeous transparent white glaze for a hint of sheen

items.label: CRISP WHITE SHADE
items.value: The hardback fabric drum shade in a neutral hue enhances a bedroom, living room or entry area, perfectly suited to fit right in with clean and modern or cool and eclectic

items.label: ELEVATE THE DECOR
items.value: Table lamps have form and function. Whether placed on a small table or bedside nightstand, they illuminate an area while creating an ambiance that shows off your style

items.label: DIMENSIONS
items.value: 11" W x 11" D x 19.75" H. On/Off switch; 1 E26 socket; type A bulb recommended (not included); max 60W or CFL 13W

items.label: INSTANT STYLE
items.value: Simply attach lamp shade to base and see how it fits right in with your decor

items.value: Basement, Bedroom, Dining Room, Entryway, Office
